phase: 9B.1 — real accounts, cloud career, My EraClash

authentication.google: OAuth via the provider, PKCE, prompt=select_account
authentication.email: one-time code (OTP) or magic link, no password anywhere in the product
authentication.callback: /auth/callback — code exchanged after the address bar is scrubbed; only same-origin returns
authentication.signOut: provider session ended, state cleared in memory, guest play intact

cloudCareer.architecture: the browser reads its own rows under RLS; the authoritative save runs server-side on api/profile.js and adds no function
cloudCareer.guestClaim: ownership proved by the result record's server-minted device session against the caller's HttpOnly cookie
cloudCareer.deviceImport: the browser proposes candidate ids; every one is authorised on its own
cloudCareer.idempotency: unique (user_id, result_id) plus result_claims.result_id as a primary key
cloudCareer.crossDevice: not verifiable without a provider; nothing authoritative is kept in localStorage

myEraClash.profile: initials, display name (editable, cleaned, capped), free account, member since
myEraClash.careerSummary: games, record, win rate, current streak — all derived, with an honest zero state
myEraClash.recentClashes: expandable disclosure rows with roster, coaches, era, MVP and candidate identity
myEraClash.savedReports: reopened from the stored snapshot, never recomputed by a newer candidate

crossUserIsolation.method: policy analysis of the applied DDL plus a two-user simulation against an adapter that implements the same rules; not yet executed against a live Postgres (no provider credentials in this shell)

security.tokenProtection: Authorization header only; never a URL, a log, an artifact or a telemetry property
security.serviceRoleProtection: server-only variable, absent from every bundle (scanned)

tests.vitestNote: Verified by a re-run on the restored tree. The one failure inside the gate run was tests/v9b1-accounts.test.js correctly detecting that preview:wave2-access-audit had rewritten data/validation/9a3 during an earlier run; the gate runner now restores prior-phase evidence before and after, and no product code was changed.
